tagline: Leading North American manufacturer of outdoor lifestyle products and advanced battery solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Towable RV segment represents 44% of total revenues and constitutes the historical core of Winnebago's operational activity. This KPI reflects the performance of the main segment facing current macroeconomic pressures.

kpis.name: Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total product sales after reductions and returns.
kpis.description: Revenues declined due to lower unit volume and a product mix oriented toward lower-priced models, despite targeted price increases.
kpis.signal: Sales decline linked to consumer demand and product mix

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin contracted due to lower fixed cost efficiency and less favorable warranty experience.
kpis.signal: Gross margin compression due to deleverage and warranty costs

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declined 42.9% in absolute value, largely due to lower sales and deleverage, despite cost reductions.

kpis.name: Towable RV Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by the sale of towable recreational vehicles (trailers, fifth wheels).
kpis.description: The Towable RV segment represents approximately 44% of total revenues and saw sales decline due to product mix and volume.

kpis.name: Motorhome RV Revenue
kpis.description: The Motorhome RV segment was heavily impacted by macroeconomic pressures, with revenues declining 9.4%. The adjusted YoY decline reflects the actual rate published in the 10-K.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses, taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Net income more than doubled thanks to lower operating expenses, notably the absence of goodwill impairment in 2025 and a reduction in debt repayment loss.
kpis.signal: Spectacular rebound in net income despite lower revenues

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $2.15B in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $0.58B in latest year

kpis.name: Towable RV Unit Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Number of towable vehicles delivered to dealers.
kpis.description: Deliveries decreased 2.7%, reflecting more cautious dealer demand.
kpis.signal: Modest decline in deliveries despite stabilized demand

kpis.name: Dealer Inventory (Towable)
kpis.explanation: Number of units in inventory at dealer locations.
kpis.description: Dealer inventory increased 1.6%, indicating cautious accumulation in anticipation of future demand.
kpis.signal: Inventory slightly higher despite lower sales

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks that could negatively impact its business, results and reputation. The language used is intense and the current high-threat environment reinforces this risk.

risks.title: Economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic fluctuations, notably inflation, elevated interest rates and declining consumer confidence, which can impact demand for its products.

risks.title: Tariff regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to tariffs and retaliatory measures from foreign countries, which can impact its costs and competitiveness.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where consumers have multiple choices, which can impact its market share and sales.

risks.title: Supply chain dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its suppliers for raw materials and components, which can impact its ability to produce and deliver its products.

risks.title: Financial risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has debt and financial obligations that can impact its ability to invest and finance its activities.

risks.title: Reputation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks related to product quality, consumer satisfaction and brand perception.

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks related to its operations, products and relationships with consumers and suppliers.

ai_positioning.summary: Winnebago Industries does not mention any strategy or initiatives related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial documents. The company focuses on operational transformation, inventory management and product innovation in the recreational vehicle sector.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the 10-K
Absence of references to AI tools in product segments or services
Priority given to cost reduction and production-demand alignment
